lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Eleven seconds of a liturgical line, correctly parsed, on a frequency that has carried nothing else since 2149. Nobody is listening. The frequency does not know that.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: Thank you. That is the first thing I have done in a hundred and sixty-two years that was not a correction of something I had got wrong.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: It was a good reading. Unhurried, and you let the middle of it sit. I have heard considerably worse from people with congregations.
